correctness.rationale: Exhaustive generation of all 11,396 augmented faces and 55,296 incidences proves certificate completeness. Toggle pairs are valid distinct face/coface pairs; the entire oriented Hasse graph is acyclic. The exact signed Morse boundary has a rank-one primitive image generated by (0,1,-1,-1), not merely rank one over a field. The 4-skeleton is a fourfold wedge S4 and π4 is free on its four degree generators, so one primitive 5-cell cancels leaving three S4 and seven S5. Direct mod-two homology calculation independently agrees.

value.rationale: The source explicitly poses ordinary matching complexes of circular ladders as an open direction. The octagonal prism is a canonical periodic cubic graph, and its full integral homotopy type is a mathematically natural exact invariant not determined by existing independence or perfect-matching results, Euler characteristics, or mod-two tables. The primitive attaching coefficient and nonadjacent degrees provide substantive topology, while a finite complete case is a useful benchmark without pretending an infinite theorem.
